INTRODUCTION

JAHAAN (2025)JAHAAN (2025)

APPROACH

Jahaan is a story about culture, and the pursuit of identity. I treated it as a study of visual and surrealist storytelling, where the approach was to communicate beyond the surface and challenge the film form.

ROLE

Writer, Director, Editor, and Sound Post Production.

TWO PACKETS OF SUGAR, TRUST ME. (2025)TWO PACKETS OF SUGAR,TRUST ME. (2025)

APPROACH

I have always been interested in films that use stylised storytelling. “Two Packets of Sugar, Trust Me.” is an attempt to tell an intimate story of self-reflection in a similarly elevated style.

ROLE

Writer, Director, Editor, and Sound Post Production.

ROOTS (2026)ROOTS (2026)

APPROACH

As someone who is interested in narratives pertaining to identity and culture, Chef Monal Malhotra’s story really resonated with me. Interconnecting the story between the modern day and the 90s was both exciting and daunting given the small scale, run-and-gun nature of the production.

ROLE

Co-Writer, Director, Editor, and Sound Post Production.

THE GUEST ROOM (2025)THE GUEST ROOM (2025)

APPROACH

Socio-political commentary and analysis is one of the prime ways that filmmaking can engage in important dialog. The Guest Room is about the unfeeling nature of capitalism and how it has adverse effects on people on a micro and macro scale.

ROLE

Co-Writer, Art Director, and Assembly Editor.

TILL DEATH DO US PART (2025)TILL DEATH DO US PART (2025)

APPROACH

Till Death Do Us Part is a dissection of relationships and the complexity of opposing natures in the context of love. While the film’s approach is absurdist, there is a sincerity at the core which drives it.

ROLE

Co-Writer and Script Supervisor.

COURTESY OF CUBAN EVANGELICAL BOB (2024)COURTESY OF CUBANEVANGELICAL BOB (2024)

APPROACH

Artists tend to struggle quite a bit with imposter syndrome. Within this story, both the protagonists, Nicky and Patrick act as the personifications of self-doubt and belief. Using comedy as a medium of expression, the short film tells the story of aspiring artists.

ROLE

Writer, Director, Editor, and Sound Post Production.
